title: Google Calendar integration (Calendar & Video Conferencing) | Xobin
text:
About Google Calendar
Google Calendar is Google's scheduling service for individuals and teams. It handles events, invitations, reminders and shared availability, and is the calendar of record for most organisations running on Google Workspace.
Why Integrate Google Calendar with Xobin?
Integrating Google Calendar with Xobin simplifies interview scheduling and saves time. Scheduled events sync automatically, ensuring smooth coordination between recruiters and candidates. With customisable time slots, instant updates and easy rescheduling, the integration removes manual effort and keeps the hiring process organised.
How to Integrate Google Calendar with Xobin
Access the Xobin dashboard
Log in to your Xobin account and open the
Dashboard
In the left-hand menu click
Interviews
to access or create interviews for candidates.
Connect Google Calendar
Locate the option to connect your calendar within the Interviews section.
Select the Google account to connect and sign in if prompted.
Grant Xobin permission to view, edit and share calendar events.
Confirm the integration
Once permissions are granted the integration is established.
You can now manage interview scheduling from Xobin, with events syncing to Google Calendar.
Configure availability
Choose from default durations such as 15, 30 or 60 minutes, or set a custom duration.
Click
Create
in the Xobin dashboard to schedule an interview.
Fill in the event name, candidate name and candidate email.
Choose whether the candidate selects a time slot or the interview is scheduled immediately.
Schedule and manage interviews
Select the date and time slot for the interview.
The event appears on your Google Calendar timeline.
Start the interview from the Xobin dashboard or the Google Calendar link.
Reschedule or cancel interviews directly within Xobin.
Who is this integration for?
This integration is ideal for recruiters, hiring managers and HR teams looking to streamline scheduling. Whether you are managing high-volume interviews or coordinating with multiple stakeholders, it ensures smooth communication, efficient scheduling and better time management for organisations that want a simpler recruitment workflow and a stronger candidate experience.
Capabilities
Features & benefits
One-click Google account connect
Authorise Xobin to view, edit and share calendar events from the Interviews section and scheduling is live.
Configurable interview durations
Use 15, 30 or 60 minute defaults, or set a custom duration to match your interview format.
Candidate-selected slots
Let candidates pick a time from your availability, or schedule the interview immediately yourself.
Reschedule and cancel in Xobin
Events appear on your Google Calendar timeline and can be moved or cancelled from the Xobin dashboard.
No double-booked interviews
Xobin reads your Google availability, so slots are only offered when your calendar is genuinely free.
Invites and reminders handled for you
Candidates and panellists receive the calendar invite with all interview details the moment a slot is confirmed.
